shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!dist'"' && rg --files app src pages 2>/dev/null | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.* && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/catalog/page.tsx && rg --files app components lib | sort"
/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/data.ts && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | sort && git status --short && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('playwright').then(m => console.log(typeof m.chromium.launch)).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1) })\" && rg -n \"exports|instant\" node_modules/@next/playwright/package.json | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
root = Path('/home/sandbox/workspace')
for filename in ('next-env.d.ts', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'):
    path = root / filename
    if path.is_file():
        path.unlink()
build = root / '.next'
if build.is_dir():
    shutil.rmtree(build)
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
